paragraphs: The SLK230 was part of the first-generation SLK (R170) range, produced from 1996 to 2004. It uses the M111 - a 2.3-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine that was widely used across Mercedes models of that era. The SLK230 was the mid-range petrol option in the R170 line-up, sitting between the SLK200 and the V6-powered SLK320. The SLK was discontinued in 2016 and succeeded by the SLC, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SLK230 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.3-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the SLK230 throughout the R170 generation (1996-2004). No specific known issue has been independently confirmed for this engine in SLK230 application. We replace timing chain, timing gears and gaskets as standard on every M111 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the SLK230 only uses one engine across its entire production run - the M111 - there's less compatibility risk than with models that changed engine code mid-generation. However, we still confirm your exact build before we quote anything:
